card.name: The word Grade in toxicity severity
card.fires_on: The word Grade (or grade, graded) right before a severity number in adverse-event text, mostly in dose-modification rules. It also fires on the end of Toxicity in the NCI criteria name.

modes.label: Grade before a number
modes.description: The word Grade appears after a threshold sign or 'to' and before a severity number in dose-hold rules.
modes.example: Withhold OMCAZIO until improvement to ≤<<Grade>> 1, resume OMCAZIO

modes.label: Grading system wording
modes.description: Words naming the grading scale itself, such as graded or Toxicity in the NCI criteria title.
